sections.title: Tree and flowers
sections.text: Prunus avium, sweet cherry or wild cherry, is a deciduous tree usually 15–20 m tall and sometimes reaching 30 m. Its leaves are about 8–15 × 4–7 cm. White flowers, about 2–3 cm across, grow in small umbels.

sections.title: Fruit and toxicity
sections.text: The ripe fleshy fruit is eaten as a cherry. Leaves, flowers, unripe fruits, stalks and especially the stones contain cyanogenic glycosides; the kernels inside the stones should not be eaten.
